entry.notRun: no live runtime: only the stored records and indexes
entry.runs: store-summary-visibility.mjs, store-summary-index.mjs, store-summary-reader.mjs, store/listing.mjs, store-transcript-projection.mjs projectStoredTranscript, manager/turn-checkpoint.mjs recorder, all over session files in a temp data dir

exclusions.case 2: closed Lead and agent checkpoint: the projected transcript of a closed record is produced by the session transcript read, not by mixdog-store; owner: mixdog-core-session
exclusions.case 4: ordinarySummaries, ordinarySumma: the reader projection of the list row (a subset of its fields, with the file stat) is built by the thread list, not by mixdog-store; owner: mixdog-core-session thread_list.rs
exclusions.case 4: storedSessions, storedSessionsIn: the session documents and transcript reads of Node session files; Rust holds sessions as logs and reads them in mixdog-core-session; owner: mixdog-core-session
exclusions.case 4: storedWorkers, workerLinks: the agent worker index (agent-workers.json) is not held by mixdog-store; owner: mixdog-core-session agent_registry pool_docs.rs and mixdog-core-agents pool_list.rs
exclusions.cases 0 and 1: agent descendants and age: no counterpart in mixdog-store; owner: mixdog-core-session agent_registry (mod.rs descendants)

normalised.reason: the temp data dir is written <data>; a projection stamp starts with the transcript worker epoch (a per-run number), written <epoch>; a projection stamp without a fingerprint is <process id>:<clock>:<counter>, the process id written <pid>

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder
